sentences.text: Yes—the KFS must include a computation sheet of APR and the amortisation schedule of the loan over the loan tenor. [E8]
APR shall include all charges which are levied by a UCB. [E9]

The KFS means a standardised statement of the key terms of a loan, including the annual percentage rate (APR), the fees and charges and the repayment schedule, provided to the borrower before execution of the loan contract. [E1]
